summary: Support for traditional artisans and craftspeople through collateral-free loans, skill training, and toolkit incentives.

benefit.displayText: Collateral-free loan up to ₹3 lakh at 5% interest

eligibility.displayText: Must be engaged in one of the 18 recognized traditional trades (e.g., carpenter, tailor, goldsmith, potter)

exclusions: Must not have availed loans under similar central/state schemes (PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, Mudra) in the past 5 years
applicationSteps: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) to apply
Wait for Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body verification

sources.title: PM Vishwakarma Official Portal
sources.publisher: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
